gksr.settings.group.title: GK2 Sermon Reminder
gksr.settings.beacon.label: Enable church beacon
gksr.settings.beacon.description: On Sermon Day, if you haven’t held a sermon yet, place a persistent beacon pointing to the church. Enabled by default.
gksr.status.reminderUnavailable: [Sermon Reminder] Unable to read the required game state. Reminders are temporarily unavailable.
gksr.status.hudUnavailable: [Sermon Reminder] The corner HUD reminder is unavailable.
gksr.diagnostics.reminderUnavailable: [Sermon Reminder] Failed to read the required game state. Check the logs for details. If you are certain this is a bug, please open an issue on GitHub.
gksr.diagnostics.hudUnavailable: [Sermon Reminder] The reminder cannot be displayed in the corner HUD. Check the logs for details. If you are certain this is a bug, please open an issue on GitHub.
gksr.popup.sermon.title: Sermon Day
gksr.popup.sermon.body:
Today is Sermon Day! Don’t forget to head to the church and hold a sermon!

You’re seeing this pop-up because you manually enabled the Ultimate Reminder. If you find it unnecessary, you can disable it in the settings.
gksr.settings.popup.label: Ultimate Reminder
gksr.settings.popup.description: Force a pop-up to appear when Sermon Day arrives as an ultimate reminder. Disabled by default.
